name: Turtle Bay
source_title: Turtle Bay Bath menu, dish pop-ups (read 2026-10-10, no date shown)
sites_evidence: The restaurant dropdown on https://turtlebay.co.uk/menu lists 43 restaurants (Bath to Winchester); the site's own menu feed (tb-menu-proxy.herokuapp.com/restaurant/<slug>) returns the same dishes, calories and allergens for all 43.
note: Calories only. The chain's own menu feed shows the same menu in all 43 restaurants (checked: no dish differs in calories or allergens between them). Some dishes show no calories (left out). Drinks and alcohol are not included.
